questions.text:
Question 6 – 8: Comprehension Passage


The Rise of Digital Marketing
Over the last decade, digital marketing has become an essential tool for businesses of all sizes. Unlike traditional marketing methods such as television or newspaper ads, digital marketing allows brands to reach customers directly through online platforms such as social media, email, and search engines.
One of the major advantages of digital marketing is its ability to track user behavior. Marketers can now analyze how many people clicked on an ad, how long they stayed on a website, and even which products they viewed before making a purchase. This data helps companies understand their audience and improve their campaigns in real time.
Moreover, digital marketing is cost-effective. Small businesses with limited budgets can run targeted ads to specific audiences based on age, location, interests, and more, something not easily achievable with traditional marketing.
As the world becomes increasingly digital, the demand for skilled digital marketers continues to grow. Companies are actively hiring professionals who understand SEO, content marketing, analytics, and paid advertising strategies.

Question:
According to the passage, what is one key benefit of digital marketing over traditional marketing?
options: It allows better tracking and analysis of user behavior
It uses television to reach users

questions.text: Why is digital marketing considered cost-effective for small businesses?
options: It allows targeted ads based on user demographics

options: More companies are shifting to digital platforms
